title: payment.refunded
description: Published by billing-service (RabbitMQ order.exchange, ADR-0034) once PaymentService.refundPayment confirms a refund. Consumed by orders-service, driving REFUNDING -> REFUNDED. transactionId is the original charge's reference, never overwritten by the refund -- no refund-specific identifier is modeled (ADR-0034). Never carries failureReason.
